source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
How a **force** uses army and **detachment rules**:

- In a **unified force**, army rules treat the **force** as one army.
- Otherwise, every army in a **force** follows its own army rules.
- If both players in a **unified force** chose the same **detachments**, **detachment rules** work for the **force** as for a single army.
- Otherwise, a player's **detachment rules** affect only enemy units and that player's own army, in a **unified force** too.

armyRuleScope.otherwise: each army uses its own army rules

detachmentRuleScope.otherwise: affects only enemy units and units in the player's own army, even in a unified force
